# Gabriele Belotti, PhD

> Independent consultant and biomedical engineer based in Milan, Italy, specialising
> in X-ray imaging software and systems: CBCT and cone-beam tomographic reconstruction,
> image quality and detector characterisation, geometric (flexmap) calibration,
> Monte Carlo simulation, and embedded electronics for medical and industrial imaging
> devices. PhD from Politecnico di Milano on in-room image guidance for hadron therapy.

## Summary

- Name: Gabriele Belotti (Gabriele Belotti, PhD)
- Role: Independent X-ray imaging software and systems consultant
- Location: Milan, Italy. Available for remote and on-site work across Europe.
- Contact: gabriele.belotti@polimi.it
- Languages: Italian (native), English (fluent), French (intermediate)
- Past roles: X-Ray Image-Processing / Software Engineer at Cefla; Head of the Imaging
  Core Group (15 people) at medPhoton; Researcher in Computer-Aided Radiation Therapy
  at Politecnico di Milano (robotic C-arm for the CNAO particle therapy centre);
  Visiting PhD Researcher at INSA Lyon / CREATIS; Research Engineer intern at ICube Lab.

## Consulting areas

- Image quality and CBCT validation (algorithm parametrisation, phantom and clinical
  data analysis, flat panel detector QC to IEC standards)
- Tomographic reconstruction (cone-beam pipelines, field-of-view extension, scatter
  correction; RTK, ITK/VTK, custom C++/CUDA)
- Geometric calibration of robotic systems (flexmap calibration, 9-degree-of-freedom
  calibration, Factory Acceptance Test validation)
- Monte Carlo simulation (Geant4 / OpenGATE, scatter studies, synthetic data, Slurm/HPC)
- Embedded systems and instrument electronics (sensor integration, detector and
  acquisition electronics, microcontroller firmware, hardware/software co-design)
- Medical device software development (C++/Python, DICOM, CI, regulated clinical software)
- C++ codebase development and long-term maintenance for imaging and industrial machinery
- Technical leadership for R&D imaging teams

## Engagement models

Fixed-scope project (4-8 weeks); ongoing technical advisory retainer (a few hours a
month); embedded engineer (3-6 months full-time); fractional technical lead (1-2 days
a month); one-off assessment or second opinion (1-3 days).

## Selected publications

- Belotti G. et al. (2024). Extension of the cone-beam CT field-of-view using two
  complementary short scans. Medical Physics 51(5), 3391-3404.
  https://doi.org/10.1002/mp.16869
- Belotti G. et al. (2023). A new system for in-room image guidance in particle
  therapy at CNAO. Physica Medica 114, 103162.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ejmp.2023.103162
- Belotti G., Rit S., Baroni G. (2022). Extension of the cone-beam CT field-of-view
  using two short scans with displaced centers of rotation. Proc. SPIE XCT22.
  https://doi.org/10.1117/12.2646384
- PhD thesis: Development of Technologies for In-Room Image Guidance in Hadron Therapy,
  Politecnico di Milano, 2024 (cum laude).
